general_information.Description: Perspective is a subject that helps students draw third dimention objects on a flat surface like the image when we look at the object in real life. Perspective drawing is concerned with achieving a sense of space, of depth and of the third dimension, within the limits of the flat drawing surface. Students can use the rules of perspective in sketching, finding ideas and creativity in designing.For those concerned with freehand perspective is provided all the important printciples, insights and "shortcuts" necessary for effective drawing and life sketching. Essentially, perspective drawing deals with this appearance of things, i.e., with how three dimensional reality "look" and how it is best drawn on two dimensional surface as a canvas, sketch pad, or illustration board.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Internet, computer - Paper A4, A3, Drawing tools -Computer for drawing and presentation.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the basic rules, concept of perspective

Understand How we see for perspective drawing and Why appearance differs from reality theory, concept of Picture plane, Cone of Vision. Understand concept of Vanishing points and eyes level, how to find vanishing point, eyes level on the picture plane, vanishing point of specical lines.

Classify types of perspective: One point perspective, two point perspective, three point perspective. Know about concept and application of four, five, six, perspective. Understand and be able to draw one, two, three points perspective of objects with the determined size
Apply AI tools to generate references and suggestions for perspective drawings, while ensuring originality and accuracy. Having a positive attitude and a professional working style
Classify shade and shadow.Be able to draw shade and shadow of objects with sunlight source and Local point Sources of light to draw pictures.
Understand concept of Reflection. Be able to draw water, mirror reflections of perspective drawing

Understand Method of perspective sketching , such as: - Draw perspective of objects from simple shape. -How to determine heights, depths and widths of objects in perspective -Use Diagonals to divide to equal spacing and determine the center point of objects -Dividing a Surface into Unequal Space and Equal Space by using a measuring line and special vanishing point. Apply perspective drawing methods to draw sketches.

assessments.Grading Guide: 1. Students use pens, pencils, and rulers to draw a perpective sketch on A3 paper. 2. Submit the drawing in class.

assessments.Question Type: Students draw 10-12 pictures that represent a story. Use the methods of perspective sketching and one point, two point, three point perspective on these pictures.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - Understand Method of perspective sketching , such as: + Draw perspective of objects from simple shape. + How to determine heights, depths and widths of objects in perspective + Use Diagonals to divide to equal spacing and determine the center point of objects + Dividing a Surface into Unequal Space and Equal Space by using a measuring line and special vanishing point. - Apply perspective drawing methods to draw sketches, and develop to a sequence of pictures represent a story.
assessments.Grading Guide: 1. Students can choose an existing script or create a new one for the story of lab 5. AI tools can be used to generate a script. Discuss with instructor about the relevance of the outcome. 2. Develop sketches with the script. Students can use AI to generate pictures following the script as reference for the work. Discuss with instructor. 3. Students finish the final result, revision log, AI usage log, and submit in class
assessments.Note: Submission Files: - Final document including drawing of shades and shadows with clear presentation of steps of drawing (PDF). - Students submit works in class if work is done by hand drawing. - Document containing all development steps, including AI Usage Report: Screenshots or notes showing prompt input, AI-generated references/script output suggestion, with a reflection of how they supported final work (.docx/PDF) In-class work: - Presentation of the script analysis and stoyboard based on chosen script. - Peer and instructor feedback on scripts, sketches, and references. - Drafting and revising drawings during In-class sessions.

assessments.Question Type: Take photographs, find and analyze the perspective elements in the photographs, like vanishing point, eyes level, vanishing point of specical lines. Explain why appearance differs from reality theory.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - Knowledge: Understand the basic rules, concept of perspective. Understand why appearance differs from reality theory, understand concept of Vanishing points and eyes level, how to find vanishing point, eyes level on the picture plane, vanishing point of specical lines. - Skills: Analyze pictures for perspective fundamentals and basic concepts
assessments.Grading Guide: 1. Students take a number of photographs following instruction in the area. Students may use AI generated pictures or existing pictures for reference. Discuss with the instrcutor about the relevance of the photographs taken. 2. Students choose suitable pictures and analyze the perspective elements in the photographs, edit and highline the perspective elements using digital drawing tools like Adobe Illustrator. 3. Combine unedited and edited pictures into a report.
assessments.Note: Submission Files: - Final document including the original photographs, analyzed photographs, and additional analysis if needed. - Original drawing files if required (PDF). In-class work: - Peer and instructor feedback on photographs and analysis drawing.
